rag.text:
Test: TC-99001 — Admin journey — create Select custom field and verify in entity form
Priority: High | Status: Reference | Type: Manual
Folder: /Neutral/Admin - Custom fields
Labels: neutral-golden, journey

Steps:
1. Navigate to **Settings → Custom fields** as product admin
   Expected: Custom fields page opens with list or empty state
2. Click **Add custom field**
   Expected: Create form opens
3. Enter **Name** and choose **Select** type with two options
   Data: Name: Work Area; options: A, B
   Expected: Values editor accepts options
4. Save the field
   Expected: Success message; field appears in admin list
5. Open **Create entity** flow for a supported record type
   Expected: Create modal shows the new field
6. Set the Select value and submit
   Data: Value: A
   Expected: Record is created; field value visible on detail view
